name: Volumes — slices in position order
notes: The default `volume3d` rule keeps the default instance order
(InstanceNumber). InstanceNumber does not always follow the position of
the slice, so the stack order and the volume order can differ.
This rule claims the same instances as `volume3d`, and orders the slices
of each display set by `sliceDistance`: the distance along the normal of
the image plane, from one origin for the series. An image that is not in
the main plane has no distance, and goes after the images that have one.
Priority 79: the rule runs after `mixedDimensionalityBValue` (70) and just
before `volume3d` (80), so it claims the instances that `volume3d` would
claim. The `matches` of this rule is a copy of the `matches` of

volumePositionOrder.description: Multi-slice CT / MR / PT / NM, as volume3d, with the slices in position order.
